title: CLITestCommandOptions
description: CLI Arguments contract for ttzip-cli test command

filterPattern.description: Regex or substring pattern to filter test cases

keepTempFiles.description: Whether to keep temporary directories after execution

dumpOnFailure.description: Whether to dump memory/state on assertion failure

fast.description: Run in-process native diagnostic suites only (fast mode)

jsonReportPath.description: Optional file path to output structured JSON report

markdownReportPath.description: Optional file path to output formatted Markdown report
